im = Image.open('radiograph.jpg')

    if pct % 5 == 0:
        draw.text((x_crop + 2, 10), f'{pct}%', fill=(255, 255, 0))

crop.save('lower_arch_grid.png')
print('Saved lower_arch_grid.png')
